blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — President Ferdinand Marcos Jr. has reminded his fellow world leaders that as temporary stewards, they have a responsibility of nurturing the Association of Southeast Asian Nations (Asean) so that future generations may benefit from it. In his speech before the Gala Dinner, Marcos said his memories from his younger years when his father, former president Ferdinand Marcos Sr., met with contemporaries from founding Asean member-states remind him that no generation has ownership of the regional intergovernmental organization. Rather, officials who get to chair Asean are mere stewards tasked with fostering better relations and cooperation, so that the future […]...
